discovery_mechanism: AgentDiscoveryService — passive PATH scan for claude/codex executables
graph_construction: ProductionGraph::build_with_adapter(pool, worktree_root, repo_root, run_context, Some(adapter), Some(profile))
fallback_behavior: If no operational profiles found, falls back to ProductionGraph::build() with clear warning
role_isolation: IsolatedSessions — single profile for Planner/Evaluator, fresh session per invocation
explicit_bootstrap: bootstrap_with_explicit_profile() for acceptance runner with deterministic profile identity
